shared_elements: schematic low-relief arms running down the sides of the body
hands/forearms converging toward the front of the abdomen
horizontal belt-like band across the lower torso
circular disc or ring motif on the chest/torso
band of repeated relief symbols across the upper zone
distinct decorated head/top zone above the body
plain lower body below the belt
justification: Both depict a schematic humanoid monolith with the same vertical scheme: a decorated head/top zone bearing a row of relief motifs, low-relief arms descending the sides with hands meeting over the abdomen, a disc/ring on the torso, and a horizontal belt band above a plain lower body, all rendered in flat, outlined low relief. The biggest difference in content is that B carries clearly identifiable quadrupeds in profile and a hanging pelt-like appendage, while A's relief motifs are abstract/geometric (bands, scrolls, discs) with no recognisable animals, and A's blocky head is treated as a face-bearing headdress rather than a purely symbol-bearing slab.
